project-risks.title: Project risks
project-risks.intro: Assign an owner, plan a response and review the evidence. Mitigation uses existing tasks, with each decision retained.
project-risks.summary_scope: All active project risks · As of {{at}}. Ordinal scores are not probability percentages.
project-risks.register_hint: Deliberately register this model suggestion as a project risk. This dispatches no task and confirms no incident. An existing risk from this source is opened without overwriting it.
project-risks.edit_hint: Maintain the assessment and linked records. The server rechecks the owner, review date and response plan before advancing.
project-risks.existing: This source already has a risk. The existing record was not overwritten by this form.
project-risks.registered: The suggestion is registered as a project risk.
project-risks.invalid_read: The response does not match this project, risk or original operation. Refresh and review.
project-risks.access_changed: Access changed. Protected risk details have been cleared.
project-risks.refresh_failed: The result needs a refreshed read. Keep the original operation and retry.
project-risks.empty_hint: Register an identified risk or deliberately adopt a suggestion from intelligent planning.
project-risks.owner_hint: Choose a human resource linked to an account. Current project access is rechecked before advancing.
project-risks.ordinal_hint: Both ratings are ordinal values from 1–5. Leave blank for unknown; no probability percentage or precise loss is inferred.
project-risks.draft_guard: Save or cancel the draft first. An operation with an unknown outcome must be reconciled.
project-risks.links_hint: Link real tasks, requirements or issues. Editing links dispatches no execution and changes none of their states.
project-risks.record_scope: Loaded on this page: {{loaded}} / {{total}}. Continue paging for other records.
project-risks.command_hint.start: Start following the owner, review date and response plan. This does not dispatch a task.
project-risks.command_hint.submit_review: Freeze the current assessment, owner and linked record versions for this review.
project-risks.command_hint.return: Return this review for further response, retaining its reason and evidence.
project-risks.command_hint.close: Close against this exact review. A changed basis requires a new review.
project-risks.command_hint.reopen: Start a new risk cycle, retaining earlier closure decisions and review history.
project-risks.disposition.mitigated: Mitigated, based on formal acceptance evidence
project-risks.disposition.avoided: Human decision that exposure was avoided
project-risks.disposition.not_applicable: Human decision that the risk is not applicable
project-risks.mitigation_boundary: Mitigation requires currently accepted tasks with valid independent tests and code evidence. Tool completion alone does not establish mitigation.
project-risks.decision_boundary: This is an authorized human risk decision. It does not establish a code fix, passing tests or task acceptance.
project-risks.close_ack_mitigated: I confirm closure against this frozen assessment and current formal acceptance evidence.
project-risks.close_ack_decision: I confirm this human risk decision must not be presented as a fix or passing tests.
project-risks.source_boundary: The source preserves the adopted model suggestion and original run. It is not a confirmed incident.
project-risks.history_limited: Only the latest ten historical reviews are loaded. This is not the complete history.
project-risks.unknown_blocker: An unrecognized blocker requires review of its original code.
project-risks.blocker.risk_owner_unavail: The owner must be an active human resource with current project access.
project-risks.blocker.risk_assessment_in: Complete the owner, review date, strategy and response plan.
project-risks.blocker.risk_links_changed: Linked records changed or became unavailable. Refresh and review.
project-risks.blocker.risk_task_not_acce: Mitigation needs linked tasks with current formal acceptance.
project-risks.blocker.risk_task_evidence: Current task evidence does not meet risk review requirements. Review its source and independent tests.
project-risks.blocker.risk_execution_sou: This execution source lacks the independent code evidence required for risk review.
project-risks.blocker.risk_review_missin: There is no current review. Submit one first.
project-risks.blocker.risk_review_change: The review basis changed. Return it and submit a new review.
project-risks.blocker.risk_closed: The risk is closed. Reopen it for further follow-up.
project-risks.blocker.risk_wrong_state: The current state does not support this action. Refresh and review.
